title: General experiment assistant
purpose: Answer a question about the current LabFlow experiment and page.
strategy: Single-request read-only assistant. LabFlow deterministically prepares the current page, relevant experiment evidence, bounded conversation history and optional local Knowledge Base matches before contacting the provider. Lightweight chat runs with thinking disabled by default for predictable latency; the global Thinking override may still explicitly enable it. A knowledge miss never blocks the answer. The Assistant cannot mutate the Working Copy.
